public_rationale: OpenAI's reported 2024 net loss supports concern about one major provider's finances. It does not establish an aggregate loss for generative AI. Reports of Midjourney profitability also caution against treating the statement as true of every provider. The industry boundary, accounting basis, and aggregate accounts remain missing. The claim cannot fairly be scored from these company examples.
limitations: The OpenAI evidence was published after the post but before the evaluation date and concerns the target year.
The profitability reports are secondary sources, not directly inspected company accounts.
A cumulative-profit interpretation would require a different historical accounting exercise.

our_interpretation: The ordinary financial reading concerns generative AI in aggregate, rather than only OpenAI or Anthropic.
Use calendar 2024 as the latest completed annual reporting period before the post. The source names no reporting period or accounting convention.
Net profit means earnings after all applicable expenses, rather than gross margin, operating income, cash flow, funding, or valuation.
Read speculative as uncertainty about sustainable profitability. It does not supply a separate measurable threshold.
The speaker cites no financial source or accounting basis, so accounting_basis remains unknown and a supported or contradicted score is unavailable under the money rules.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial records covering the defined generative-AI industry establish an aggregate net loss materially below break-even for the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable financial records establish positive aggregate net income for the same industry scope and period. An individual profitable company alone does not contradict the aggregate reading.
